4.name: The Hand That Holds the Moon

1.name: The Giant Who Sat Down
1.plaque: He will get up eventually. Please do not rush him.

5.name: The Tall Grandmother
5.plaque: Mind the scarf. She has been at it a while.

3.name: The Enormous Toaster
3.plaque: It is still warm. Do not ask why.

8.name: The Elk Made of Elks
8.plaque: Do not count them. They count you.

11.name: The Wrong Nisse
11.plaque: Our first attempt. We have since improved.

15.name: The Watching Nisse
15.plaque: His eyes follow you. That is his whole job.

17.name: The Mitten
17.plaque: Lost 1871. Still looking for the other one.

14.name: The Monument to Nothing
14.plaque: In honour of the thing that was here. You know what you did.

22.name: The Face That Looks Up
22.plaque: You are standing on his cheek. He does not mind.

21.name: The Kneeling Giant
21.plaque: He is holding it for you. Do not take it.

24.name: The Granite Snowman
24.plaque: He fell over in 1966. Nobody had the heart.

26.name: The Upside-Down Bell
26.plaque: It rang once. Everyone agreed not to talk about it.

25.name: The Reindeer
25.plaque: Do not count the legs. He is sensitive.

18.name: The Ring of Seven
18.plaque: They are facing each other. Do not stand in the middle. You are standing in the middle.

29.name: The Lake Serpent
29.plaque: Please do not feed the lake.

23.name: The Cinnamon Buns
23.plaque: Please do not lick the monument.

27.name: Grandmother's Head
27.plaque: She is thinking. Let her think.

28.name: The Giant Stairs
28.plaque: There are 66 steps. There were 65 yesterday.
